# Fixtures for rd_turn_fold_ab (port/render/test/rd_turn_fold_ab.cmake: the
# present's turn drawn by its box blit against the turn pass, byte for byte,
# through the headless twin): fixture names of this repository
# (port/render/test/fixtures/NAME.rdfix), a name a line, then the word win43
# (also replayed at 1024x768, where a 4:3 frame fills the window one texel a
# pixel and must fold) and the line's own properties (rd_fixture_list_props.cmake):
# turn_fold_cases, the fold's self-test cases, on every fold run;
# turn_fold_turned on a run that folded (a line that declares it must fold).
#
# the PowerVR phone's opening (v0.11.5 rc): lamps, dark, whole; 848 GS pixels
# for 840.53 at its aspect: cropped, the turn pass kept
fx-lamps-novolume turn_fold_cases=6
fx-opening-dark turn_fold_cases=6
fx-opening-sun turn_fold_cases=6
# issue 179's Mali-G52 (a turned phone too): a stage 42 slow capture and the
# stage 3 frame; 912 GS pixels for 910.22: cropped
fx-mali-slow541 turn_fold_cases=6
fx-mali-frame turn_fold_cases=6
# a 2026-10-07 capture (4:3, 512x448 GS): folds at 1024x768
fx-vu-3086 win43 turn_fold_cases=6 turn_fold_turned>=90
